name: ONCO-X Lab
mission: Discover natural cancer-resistance mechanisms across species.
query: (cancer resistance OR tumor resistance OR neoplasia resistance) AND (species OR comparative OR evolution)

name: REGEN-X Lab
mission: Find mechanisms of scarless healing and organ/tissue regeneration.
query: (regeneration OR scarless healing OR tissue repair) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

name: NEURO-X Lab
mission: Discover neuroprotection, ischemia tolerance and neural repair mechanisms.
query: (neuroprotection OR ischemia tolerance OR brain regeneration OR neural repair) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

name: IMMUNO-X Lab
mission: Find infection tolerance and inflammation-control strategies.
query: (viral tolerance OR pathogen tolerance OR disease resistance OR inflammation control) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

name: LONGEVITY-X Lab
mission: Find longevity, DNA maintenance and proteostasis mechanisms.
query: (longevity OR exceptional lifespan OR negligible senescence) AND (DNA repair OR proteostasis OR genome maintenance OR animal)
fallback_query: (longevity OR lifespan OR aging OR senescence) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

name: METABOLIC-X Lab
mission: Find unusual metabolic control useful for diabetes, obesity and organ stress.
query: (metabolic adaptation OR fasting tolerance OR glucose regulation OR insulin sensitivity) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

name: PRESERVE-X Lab
mission: Find mechanisms for cryoprotection, hibernation and organ preservation.
query: (freeze tolerance OR hibernation OR desiccation tolerance OR organ preservation) AND (animal OR species)
